==Description==
The '''Sleigh''' was an enemy that only appeared in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It had a decent amount of health, an  average speed and 35% defense. It also, as the name suggests, used a sleigh to fly, making it a [[Flying]] enemy. This means that it could not collide with units, as well as being undetectable by a majority of towers and units.

==Appearance==
The '''Sleigh''' was a brownish orange and white sleigh. It had golden rims along most of its structure, as well as golden thrusters on the back of its feet. It had yellow headlights and small wings as well. The sleigh was piloted by an elf with pale skin. It had a green shirt with white fur along the sleeves, as well as stitch lines on the sides of the arms. It had a black belt, dark green pants and black shoes. It also wore a green Christmas hat.

==Strategy==
*As the '''Sleigh''' is a [[Flying]] enemy, it can only be attacked by towers with flying detection.
**The [[Ace Pilot]] cannot be used, as it cannot be placed down in [[Cold Ambush]].
*The [[Executioner]] can be used against this. Its bouncing mechanic also allows it to be useful at clearing out hordes of enemies that appear in [[Cold Ambush]].
*The [[Ranger]] can be quite effective against this, due to its high damage.
*The [[Engineer]] can also be used, though do note that only the [[Engineer]] itself can detect the '''Sleigh''', not its sentries.

==Trivia==
*Weirdly, the dialogue for the '''Sleigh''' appeared on Wave 15, despite its debut wave being Wave 14.
*The [[Gift Bomber]] unit from the [[Elf Camp]] is based on this enemy.
*This enemy returns in the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]] with different stats.
